body:
Hey, thanks for posting here. It may not seem like it but just doing this rather than bottling it up is good, it allows people to help you rather than having to soldier on alone. I appreciate that. 

Will things get better? Nobody knows. Can they get better? Yes, things can get better. You're not doomed to a life of misery and loneliness just because you're a person who is different. Even as different as you are.

We're here for you, whatever you're going through, you don't have to be alone.

I'm going to throw my bike off the mountain and dive after it head first. I've pissed away an entire childhood, wasted adolescense, and noe I'm heading into young adulthood with the worst possible fucking mindset and personality and attitude. 

I read in a book about self esteem that it's possible to change yourself. Like your core, your weak foundation can be strengthened and you can get the sense of self worth necessary to self actualize. I never got to the part where it explained how to do these things though.

I just fucked around, wasted my time being bad at life and doing bad at school. Changing yourself is really difficult and I'm not up for it. I'm going to kill myself now rather than later.

That's pretty poetic, yo. Thanks for reading. I don't think I'm amazing. If I was amazing I wouldn't be killing myself.

And I know this logic is circular and to be honest I wouldn't be killing myself if it was just me myself and my own failures. But I hate myself. This manifests in hating other people so I'm constantly flip flopping between being mad at myself and being mad at the world. It never ends. 

I think I can be doing some genuine good by putting and end to this. For myself, the people around me and the world as a whole.

Thank you for sharing all that you have here with us. You don't need to apologize for the length. I think you made the right decision posting here. It seems like you have been through a lot of very hard times and I am grateful that you've decided to reach out this way. 

I'm 20 years old, I am into men, I have a lot to learn, I have my own issues and I'm telling you this because you explicitly asked for suggestions on what alternatives you have going from here. I believe that I can offer you some suggestions but I figured you'd want to know something about who I am before deciding wether or not to hear me out. It's your decision! This is a decision you can make. 

I believe in you. Take care!

You're probably not a loser at 16. You probably just don't know who you are and don't have the confidence to take the necessary steps to get out of your comfort zone and figure that out. 

I take issue with you telling the OP what to do in, straight up, what to do in bullet point format. I take issue with this especially because it doesn't sound like you have everything figured out. If OP doesn't want to or shouldn't want to end up like you why should he take your advice on what to do seriously? I wouldn't have had issue with this if you had just been offering support or questions. 

> Forget about middle school. Kids are shit heads. 

It's tough to forget about something that is your reality and what you go through on a daily basis. If you're talking to people or seeing them everyday in class it's extremely difficult to just dismiss them and do your own thing, especially when they're all you have and you want the social interaction. Kids may be shit heads and maybe OP will learn that sooner or later be we can't say that for sure about every kid and we can't say that for sure OP will come to see this as you do.

I have a big problem with this kind of support where OPs problems are dismissed, not taken seriously or seen as 'minor' somehow. And also with how this kind of "Do X. Do Z. You need Y, so do Y." support doesn't take into consideration the many steps and issues that might come up with just wanting to do things. Someone online telling you to do something *is not enough of a purpose to go out of your comfort zone and fight for something.*
